claims.value: Olmo Hybrid is a 7B hybrid RNN language model featuring 75% gated DeltaNet heads, trained on 5.5 trillion tokens, with improved data efficiency and inference performance for long contexts compared to Olmo 3.
claims.evidence: We expand on our Olmo model series by introducing Olmo Hybrid, a new 7B hybrid RNN model in the Olmo family. Olmo Hybrid dramatically outperforms Olmo 3 in final performance
Language(s) (NLP): English ... auto-regressive language model ... predicting the next word in a sequence

claims.value: The model architecture consists of 32 layers with a hidden size of 3840. 75% of layers use gated DeltaNet heads with 30 heads, alternating with multihead attention layers.
claims.evidence: except that 75% of layers use gated DeltaNet heads instead of attention heads. The layers alternate so that 3 contain DeltaNet sublayers followed by 1 with a multihead attention sublayer

claims.value: Olmo Hybrid was trained on the Dolma 3 dataset, using the data mix of Olmo 3 32B, with a standard cosine learning rate schedule.
claims.evidence: These models are pre-trained on the Dolma 3 dataset ... we use the improved data mix of Olmo 3 32B ... change the learning rate schedule to be a standard cosine schedule

claims.value: The model is developed by Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) and licensed under Apache 2.0, intended for research and educational use.
claims.evidence: **Developed by:** Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) ... **License:** This model is licensed under Apache 2.0. It is intended for research and educational use

claims.value: Olmo Hybrid demonstrates roughly 2x data efficiency on core evals and improved inference efficiency (throughput and memory) on long-context lengths by a factor of 75% over Olmo 3.
claims.evidence: consistently showing roughly 2x data efficiency on core evals ... improved inference efficiency (throughput and memory) on long-context lengths by a factor of 75%
